name: Double Deflection Grille
description: The Air Master AAG is an extruded aluminium double deflection grille with aero foil adjustable front and rear blades, set at 90° to each other so airflow direction can be adjusted independently in the horizontal and vertical planes. Performance is published at two blade settings — 0° (blades parallel to airflow, maximum throw) and 45° (blades angled, wider spread, shorter throw) — across five listed neck-size groups sharing a common free-area factor. A collar-mounted volume control damper is available as an accessory.
